system.description:
All Gargoyles are born with the innate, non-Discipline ability to fly, granted by a thaumaturgical ritual worked into their creation; only Gargoyles can ever learn it, and Celerity cannot be used to increase flight speed. At Level 1 you can only glide and soar like a hang-glider, carrying nothing beyond your clothes and personal effects, at a maximum speed of 15 mph. At Level 2 you can achieve powered flight with a running takeoff, carrying up to 20 pounds, at a maximum speed of 30 mph.

Every Gargoyle begins the game with Level 1 Flight for free, and further levels are purchased with experience like a clan Discipline. Flight is represented in play by holding your arms straight out to the sides, or by another agreed-upon signal such as a colored sash.
